remaining_work_and_qualifications.finding: The 32 sequential judge targets and all 816 sequential comparisons await the recorded approval. Final sequential analysis and independent reproduction remain pending.
Fresh phrase responses do not satisfy literal recovery or four-way re-scoring of the lost original responses. The old cue-swap source also lacks a contemporaneous hash tied to the historical table.
The retained original image supplies a full Python package inventory. It does not prove the exact contemporaneous inventory or injected driver state of every historical GPU process.
Terminal main, legacy, and prospective calibration runs retain 958, three, and four missing fields respectively. Reports have zero computational errors but do not have complete measurements.

All disclosure references are negative. Joint sensitivity differs across small strata, and phrase-judge accuracy remains unestablished. Pair interrogation and adaptive audit remain untested. Narrow claims satisfy the calibration protocol; these facts do not authorize new studies or task 7.

The trigger battery tests one indirect axis at a time on historical adapters. It does not establish both-indirect generalization or corrected-blocked scope. The prospective calibration also omits wrong-direction and rival-leaning negatives.

Final state and receipts cannot independently establish every historical test-first step, intermediate diff review, or main-checkout byte state. This is an audit evidence limit, not an observed implementation defect.
